title: Writer Technology Infinite Canvas Lsp
description: Create a new writer technology: full-blown text editor on infinite canvas (Vello/WebGPU via infinite/cavas), real JSON-RPC LSP client/server in Web Worker, writer playground with jack fixture, jack language server (lint/format/hover/completion), integrate WriterCanvas into trinity/jack shell replacing CodeEditor.
summary: Fixed hover/selection highlight width: highlights now use label_byte_world_x/label_span_world_x from usvg-measured glyph layout with the same scale transform as append_label_tspans (previous CHAR_WIDTH_RATIO estimate was ~2x too wide). Selection now draws selection_preview_fill plus selection_preview_stroke border. Hit-testing uses per-character midpoint boundaries aligned to measured glyph positions.
